testing_mode: UPDATE

## Goal
Modify two existing call sites in `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` to wire the remediation loop, plus run exit-code audit across 4 locations.

## Changes

### 1. Modify _phase_poll failure branch
In the section where `gh pr checks` returns failure, add BEFORE returning failure:
```bash
# Extract run ID for remediation
local _remediate_run_id
_remediate_run_id=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId' 2>/dev/null || true)
[[ -n "$_remediate_run_id" ]] && _state_record_failed_run_id "$_remediate_run_id" 2>/dev/null || true
```
Then return 1 (existing behavior preserved).

### 2. Modify main failure flow
Find: `if ! _phase_poll "$_PR_NUMBER" "$_PR_URL"; then exit 1; fi`
Replace with:
```bash
if ! _phase_poll "$_PR_NUMBER" "$_PR_URL"; then
    _phase_remediate "$_PR_NUMBER" "$_PR_URL" || exit 2
fi
```

### 3. Exit-code audit (expanded 4-location scope)
Run this audit and update any callers doing exact equality on exit code 1 from merge-to-main.sh/merge-to-main-pr.sh:
```bash
grep -rn '\$? -eq 1\|\brc.*== 1\|exit_code.*-eq 1\|\[\[ \$? -eq 1 \]\]\|[ \$? -eq 1 ]' \
    plugins/dso/scripts/ \
    plugins/dso/skills/ \
    .github/workflows/ \
    tests/scripts/
```
Also check `|| exit 1` propagation patterns near merge-to-main calls.

## .test-index
Remove all 9 RED markers added in T3 AFTER confirming all 9 tests pass GREEN.

## Verify

Verify T3 tests 1-2 GREEN (wiring):
```
bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -cE "^PASS.*(t_state_record_failed_run_id|t_phase_poll_records)" 
```
Must output `2`

Verify test 9 GREEN (main flow skips remediate on poll success):
```
bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "^PASS: t_main_flow_skips_remediate_on_poll_success"
```

Verify all 9 T3 tests GREEN:
```
bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -cE "^PASS.*(t_state_record_failed_run_id|t_phase_poll_records|t_dispatch_fix_agent|t_phase_remediate|t_main_flow_skips)"
```
Must output `9`

Verify no callers check rc==1 for merge-to-main exit contract (outcome-based — must be 0 lines):
```
grep -rn 'merge-to-main.*\$? -eq 1\|merge-to-main-pr.*rc.*== 1' plugins/ .github/ tests/ | wc -l
```
Rationale: this grep confirms no legacy callers will silently mishandle the new exit-2 contract for _phase_remediate failure.

Verify existing t_poll_* unaffected (regression guard):
```
bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL): t_poll"
```
All must show PASS.

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (modify 2 existing call sites)
- .test-index (remove 9 RED markers after all 9 tests GREEN)
